Before you view this
Fancy Analysis turns your child's play into a simple summary — favorite games, response speed, favorite animals, drawing style, and time spent playing. This is just a fun snapshot of play patterns, not a psychological, developmental, or medical assessment, and should never be used to diagnose or label your child. It's visible only to you, in your account. Tap 'I Agree' to turn it on — you can turn it off anytime in Settings.
Two independent analyses — Play Together sessions are measured separately from solo play.
